```{r}

all_m_values <- readRDS(here("data/GSE223817_m.rds"))
```

# Normalise counts

For visualisation purposes, remove batch effect

```{r}
y <- DGEList(GSE234354_counts[GSE234354_gene_annotations$ensembl_id,rwh_pheno$sample_id])
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
nc <- cpm(y, log=TRUE)
```

```{r}
covariates <- model.matrix(~ rna_batch, data=rwh_pheno)
nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, covariates=covariates[,-1])

# # Functionally the same as using the batch argument, but intercept for each 
# # gene is slightly different
# nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, batch=rwh_phenotype$rna_batch)
```


```{r}
# Normalise M-values
covariates <- model.matrix(~ sentrix_id + recruiment, data=phenotype)
all_m_values_norm <- limma::removeBatchEffect(all_m_values, covariates=covariates[,-1])

# Only use filtered probes
all_m_values_norm <- all_m_values_norm[rownames(m_values),]
```

```{r}
gc()
```

# Cycle time

```{r}
# pheno <- rwh_pheno %>% filter(! is.na(ever_pregnant))
pheno <- rwh_pheno %>%
  mutate(age_scaled=scale(age)[,1]) %>%
  mutate(cycle=case_when(
    time < 9 | time > 99 ~ "men",
    time < 59 ~ "pro",
    TRUE ~ "sec"
  ))  %>% 
  filter(! is.na(ever_pregnant)) %>%
  mutate(group=paste0(cycle, "_", ever_pregnant))
```

```{r}
nrow(pheno)
```

```{r}
# X <- cSplineDes(pheno$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=10))[,-9]
X <- cSplineDes(pheno$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=4))[,-3]
design <- model.matrix(~ ever_pregnant + age_scaled + X + plate, pheno)
# head(design)
```

```{r}
fit <- lmFit(m_values[,pheno$sample_id], design=design)
fit <- eBayes(fit, robust=TRUE)
decideTests(fit) %>% abs %>% colSums
```

```{r}
top_cycle <- topTable(fit, coef=4:5, n=Inf, sort.by="F")
```

```{r}
table(top_cycle$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
```

```{r}
mean(top_cycle$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
```


```{r}
table(top_cycle$adj.P.Val < 0.01)
```


```{r}
mean(top_cycle$adj.P.Val < 0.01)
```


```{r}
hist(top_cycle$P.Value, breaks=100)
```

```{r}
}
```

# Sliding window (numeric)

```{r}
pheno <- rwh_pheno %>%
  mutate(age_scaled=scale(age)[,1]) %>%
  mutate(cycle=case_when(
    time < 9 | time > 99 ~ "men",
    time < 59 ~ "pro",
    TRUE ~ "sec"
  ))  %>% 
  filter(! is.na(ever_pregnant)) %>%
  mutate(group=paste0(cycle, "_", ever_pregnant))
dim(pheno)
```


```{r}
n_samples_in_group <- 30
window_size <- 10

tmp1 <- pheno
tmp1$time <- tmp1$time - 100
tmp2 <- pheno
tmp2$time <- tmp2$time + 100
sliding_window_pheno <- rbind(tmp1, pheno, tmp2)

set.seed(123)
results_list_1 <- list()
results_list_2 <- list()
for (i in 0:99) {
  # Subset for testing
  # if (i %% 10 != 0) {
  #   next
  # }
  
  range_a <- c(i - window_size, i + window_size - 1)
  df_a <- sliding_window_pheno %>% filter(time %>% between(range_a[1], range_a[2]))
  stopifnot(nrow(df_a) >= n_samples_in_group)
  index_a <- sample(1:nrow(df_a), n_samples_in_group, replace=FALSE)
  subset_pheno <- df_a[index_a,]
  
  design <- model.matrix(~time, subset_pheno)
  fit <- lmFit(m_values[,subset_pheno$sample_id], design=design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  top <- topTable(fit, coef=2, n=Inf)
  midpoint <- i + 0.5
  results_list_1[[as.character(midpoint)]] <- top %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% rownames()
  results_list_2[[as.character(midpoint)]] <- list()
  results_list_2[[as.character(midpoint)]][["p_0.05"]] <- sum(top$P.Value < 0.05)
  results_list_2[[as.character(midpoint)]][["p_0.01"]] <- sum(top$P.Value < 0.01)
  results_list_2[[as.character(midpoint)]][["adjp_0.05"]] <- sum(top$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
  results_list_2[[as.character(midpoint)]][["adjp_0.01"]] <- sum(top$adj.P.Val < 0.01)
  
  if (i %% 10 != 0) {
    gc()
  }
}
```


```{r}
plot(sapply(results_list_2, \(l) {l[["p_0.05"]]}), pch=16)
abline(h=nrow(m_values) * 0.05)
```

```{r}
plot(sapply(results_list_2, \(l) {l[["p_0.01"]]}), pch=16)
abline(h=nrow(m_values) * 0.01)
```

```{r}
plot(sapply(results_list_2, \(l) {l[["adjp_0.05"]]}), pch=16)
```

```{r}
plot(sapply(results_list_2, \(l) {l[["adjp_0.01"]]}), pch=16)
```

```{r}
results_list_2[[1]]
plot(sapply(results_list_2, \(l) {l[["adjp_0.05"]]}), pch=16)
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=10}
tmp <- sapply(results_list_2, \(l) {l[["adjp_0.01"]]/nrow(m_values)})
dat <- data.frame(time=as.numeric(names(tmp)),
                  p_sig=tmp * 100)

ggplot(dat, aes(x=time, y=p_sig)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank()) +
  labs(x="Model Cycle Time", y="% Significant CpG Sites")
```
